1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __greater than 600 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __specific multivalent cation crosslinker selected from the group consisting of zirconium, aluminum, and iron__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __specifically polyethylenimine with a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other anionic polymers__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein the zirconium compound is present in an amount sufficient to crosslink the polyelectrolyte complex__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein the concentration of said cations is optimized for stability in aqueous environments__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, with a preference for sizes around 200 to 800 nm__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __specifically entrapping a multivalent cation selected from the group consisting of zirconium, chromium, titanium, iron, or aluminum__.

14) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle for delivery of an oil and gas chemical to a reservoir, said composition comprising a polyethylenimine of __greater than 600 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion intimately associated with an oil and gas field chemical to form a polyelectrolyte complex, said complex having an average particle size of less than one micron.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that is capable of being crosslinked with the multivalent cation crosslinker__; and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or __other suitable polymers that can be crosslinked with the multivalent cation__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, or other aqueous fluids suitable for oil recovery applications__.
